1.title: An ICE Detention Center Roils a Colorado Town and Jolts a House Race
1.summary: Tiny Hudson, Colo., was mostly known as a speed trap between plains and suburbs. Then ICE announced it was coming, setting off months of protests.

2.title: Drought and Aging Pipes Plunge Puerto Rico Into Another Water Crisis
2.summary: Starting on Friday, the island’s water authority is scheduled to shut off water for rotating 48-hour periods in parts of San Juan and surrounding areas.

3.title: Watch: Pentagon releases fresh UFO videos in new document dump
3.summary: The fifth batch of files released on 7 August include 41 documents, images and videos related to Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena (UAP).

4.title: Seven killed after teen shooter opens fire at home and school in Thailand
4.summary: Authorities say the teen killed his grandparents at home before gunning down five teachers at his school.

5.title: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan sign defence pact
5.summary: Pakistan says an attack on any of the three will amount to an attack against all, amid conflict in the Middle East.

6.title: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan Sign Joint Defense Pact
6.summary: The agreement treats an attack on any of the countries as an attack on all, but in a region of volatile rivalries, it was unclear what that would mean in practice.
